newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Telebras to launch Level 2 ADR in 97 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Telebras to launch Level 2 ADR in 97 - paper.

text.p: Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras plans to launch a Level 2 American Depositary Receipt (ADR) in 1997, a newspaper said.
The head of Telebras' capital markets department, Heleno Silveira de Oliveira, said the company's plans to launch the ADR would be completed by the first quarter of 1997, O Globo said.
"The idea is to place the ADRs directly and not to have a public offer of the papers," Oliveira was quoted as saying by O Globo.
He said Telebras was also studying the possibility of listing its shares on the Frankfurt and Berlin stock exchanges.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
